caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object resembling a horse bit, likely a type of bridle accessory. It is composed of two vertical, parallel bars joined at the top by an arch, and at the bottom by a horizontal bar containing a mouthpiece. The left vertical bar is shaded brown with some black and white accenting, and it has a slightly wavy outline, featuring several bolts or rivet-like details. The right vertical bar and the arch over the top are more ornate, decorated with detailed black line patterns and floral motifs on a lighter, almost silvery surface. Near the bottom, both bars terminate in large, rounded ends with circular medallions, each engraved with a starburst or rosette design. Attached to each end are short, irregularly shaped bluish-gray and brown fragments, which might represent broken or worn leather straps. Above the arch, thin, black, curving lines likely represent reins or wires tied to the bridle. The entire assembly is set against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or details.
title: Bit
